title: Overgeared TV Anime Reveals More Cast in 1st Promo Video
content: The staff of Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~), the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon, revealed the anime's first key visual, first promotional video, and more cast members on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 'Tempal: Item no Chikara' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed a pair of cast members, additional staff, key visual (pictured), and a promotional video for the Tempal: Item no Chikara ( Overgeared ) television anime on Friday. The anime adapting Saenal Park and Team Argo 's action fantasy webtoon begins in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Shuiro no Kamen' Unveils Main Cast, First Promo
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 unveiled the main cast and first promotional video for the Shuiro no Kamen ( The Vermilion Mask ) television anime on Friday. The anime adapting Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's action fantasy manga is scheduled to premiere at 5:30 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! Anime's Video Reveals More Cast
content: The official website for the television anime of Haka Tokura 's Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! light novel series unveiled a new promotional video for the anime on Saturday. The video reveals more cast for the anime.
author: ANN

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime First Main Trailer and Voice Cast Revealed
content: The upcoming dark fantasy anime The Vermilion Mask has revealed its first main trailer along with the main Japanese voice cast. The anime was previously confirmed as a two-part series, set to premiere in October 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Gacha Girls Corps Anime Unveils New Trailer
content: Gacha Girls Corps anime unveiled a new trailer on Saturday as part of Crunchyroll’s anime showcase at Anime Expo 2026. It is slated to premiere in January 2027. Takashi Asami is directing the anime at studios Zero-G and Saber Works.
author: Anime Corner

title: 1st Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Anime Film to Stream on Crunchyroll on July 28
content: Crunchyroll announced at Anime Expo on Friday that it will stream Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai , the first film in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy , on its service starting on July 28 worldwide outside of Japan and Mainland China.
author: ANN
